applied.problem: "It touches instead of crossing, at a repeated root" reads as true of every repeated root, but a root repeated three times crosses, as the interactive itself shows with (x − 2)³ on screen 3; only a root repeated an even number of times touches.

"Such roots are found from a graph or by a step-by-step method of improving guesses" is too absolute: a cubic with no whole-number root can also be solved exactly, by trying fractions when the x³ has a number in front, or by the cubic formula.
